Focus Guardian uses this service exclusively to inspect visible on-screen text in English and Bangla in real-time. If a user-configured blocked word appears, it triggers a self-control penalty to return you home. No screen data is collected or uploaded.
Prevents hasty uninstallation during active focus sessions. If deactivated, configured penalty cooldown is invoked.
